items.h: Jake Bates scores eight points in win Sunday
items.s: Jake Bates went 2-for-2 on his field-goal attempts and 2-for-2 on his extra-point attempts in Sunday's 20-17 win over the Green Bay Packers. Bates did his job on Sunday, making all four of his attempted kicks in a win over the Packers. He should continue to be a good fantasy option at the kicker position moving forward, considering how effective Detroit is at moving the ball.

Bates went 2-for-2 on field-goal attempts and made both of his PATs during Sunday's 20-17 win over the Packers. Bates was able to convert multiple field-goal attempts for just the second time this season. The kicker split the uprights on a 40-yard try in the second quarter before he sent Green Bay packing with a game-winning 22-yard chip shot as time expired in regulation. Bates has yet to miss a kick this season, going 10-for-10 on field-goal tries, including a 54-yard make in Week 4 against the Panthers, while nailing all 22 of his extra-point attempts over six contests.

items.h: Jake Bates a Strong Kicker Option in Week 7
items.s: Detroit Lions kicker Jake Bates has been perfect to start the 2026 season, connecting on all eight of his field goal attempts and all 20 of his extra point tries across five games so far. In Week 7, Bates and the Lions will host the Green Bay Packers. Green Bay's defense has played well of late, allowing just 34 points over its last three games. Still, the game features two high-powered offenses and could easily turn into a high-scoring affair. With the matchup taking place inside the domed Ford Field, Bates will also not have to deal with any potential effects of weather. All in all, Bates profiles as a solid starting kicker option for fantasy managers in Week 7.

items.h: Makes six PATs, one field goal vs. Arizona
items.s: Bates made his lone field-goal attempt and converted on all six of his extra-point tries during Sunday's 45-21 win over the Cardinals. The Lions' offense scoring six touchdowns, three on the ground and three through the air, so most of Bates' work came on extra points and kickoffs, though he also connected on a 46-yard field-goal late in the second quarter to give the Lions a 24-7 lead. Bates has attempted one field goal in four of the first five games of the regular season, although his 20 extra-point makes leads the NFL. The Lions are on a bye for Week 6, so their next game will take place Week 7 at home against the Packers on Sunday, Oct. 25.

items.h: Jake Bates scores nine points in win Sunday
items.s: Jake Bates went 6-for-6 on his extra-point attempts and made his lone field-goal attempt in Sunday's 45-21 win over the Arizona Cardinals. The veteran kicker had a good game on Sunday, knocking in all seven of his kicks in the team's blowout win over Arizona. He should continue to be a good fantasy option at the kicker position for the foreseeable future.

items.h: Jake Bates a Solid Starting Kicker Option in Week 5
items.s: Across four games in 2026, Detroit Lions kicker Jake Bates has connected on all seven of his field goal attempts and all 14 of his extra point tries. Bates had his best game of the young season in Week 4, converting four field goal attempts in Detroit's loss to the Carolina Panthers. In Week 5, Bates and the Lions will take on the Arizona Cardinals. Arizona has struggled to keep its opponents off the scoreboard in recent weeks, allowing at least 31 points in each of its last three games. Detroit has also been one of the NFL's highest-scoring offenses so far, averaging 29.8 points per game. In a potentially high-scoring Week 5 affair against the Cardinals, Bates profiles as a steady top-12…

Bates connected on all four of his field-goal tries and both of his point-after attempts in Sunday's 32-26 loss to the Panthers. Bates finished with a season-high 14 points in the loss, doubling up his previous best after he totaled seven points in each of the Lions' first three contests. He got the scoring started on the night with a season-long 54-yard boot in the first quarter, then knocked down attempts of 43 and 41 yards in the second quarter before tacking on a 26-yard conversion midway through the third quarter. Bates has now gone a perfect 21-for-21 on kicks (seven field goals, 14 extra points) on the campaign.

items.h: Jake Bates nails four field goals in Week 4 loss
items.s: Jake Bates made all four of his field-goal attempts and both PATs in Sunday's 32-26 loss to the Panthers. Bates put a total of 14 points on the board Sunday night, getting four field-goal tries, as the Lions' offense had trouble finishing drives in the end zone. Bates has yet to miss any of his seven FG attempts or 14 PATs through four games. He's a great fantasy option with the Lions' high-powered offense.

items.h: Jake Bates a Risky Kicker Option in Week 4
items.s: Three games into his 2026 season, Detroit Lions kicker Jake Bates has connected on all three of his field goal attempts and converted all 12 of his extra point tries. While the 27-year-old has been effective so far and Detroit is averaging 31 points per game, Bates' fantasy production has been held down by the Lions' touchdown-scoring efficiency so far in 2026. In Week 4, Detroit will travel to Carolina to take on the Panthers. While the matchup profiles as a potentially high-scoring affair on paper, the weather forecast in Charlotte on Sunday currently calls for rain and some wind. If the elements are indeed a factor, fantasy managers should try to avoid Bates in Week 4.

Bates made a 30-yard field goal and all four of his extra-point tries in Sunday's 31-24 win over the Jets. The third-year pro is now 12-for-12 on extra-point attempts 3-for-3 on field-goal tries in 2026. Bates is also the beneficiary of an offense that has scored 31 points in all three games so far.
